mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% signals a strengthening supply side, which increases corporate earnings and boosts investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% annually) signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeds 2.5% annually and consumer sentiment (proxied by RSAFS) increases by more than 3% over 3 months, it signals a strong consumer-driven demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually and RSAFS increases > 3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 3 months and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals an aggressive easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
